scope: Two bounded CMS fixes only; no NyxID/NyxBot source modification, shared service changes, real third-party deletion, commit or push.

findings.before: POST catalog advertised required JSON with no properties; official NyxID generated call rejects this before CMS dispatch. Actual bodyless HTTP routes already work.
findings.after: No requestBody is advertised for these nine no-input POST operations. Methods, path parameters, security schemes, actual body-bearing operations and response schemas are preserved.
findings.verification: Nine independent schema assertions; 18 explicit bodyless POST route tests across CMS/service. Anonymous and current non-publisher requests are denied without ledger/provider/approval changes; authorized calls preserve lifecycle and read-only metrics.

findings.before: Retained post after removePost could fall through to published; missing/malformed post was incorrectly treated as absence.
findings.after: Removal reconciliation handles its own branch. Retained/malformed data returns unproven and Worker remains uncertain; only explicit post:null for the known ID confirms removal.
findings.verification: Worker fixture sends one remove mutation. Immediate retained read and explicit subsequent recovery preserve uncertainty, history and confirmation Trace. Retry is read-only. Later explicit absence marks both removal and prior copy removed, without a second mutation.

limits: Tests use isolated in-memory ledgers, fixture actors and stubbed provider responses; no claim of fresh real-platform or real NyxID execution.
Root must re-import this final OpenAPI into the selected local native NyxID service and verify generated operations before marking live contract accepted.
Hashnode retained soft-delete results intentionally remain uncertain/manual follow-up; removal is not proven by the mutation receipt or retained post.
Real Hashnode removal still requires concrete authorized account/content/action and authoritative verification.
Full suite and consolidated implementation commit/push remain root responsibilities.
